_: Design tokens, the single source of truth for this app's native constants.
__: Theme.swift, Theme.kt, colors.xml, the launch colorset and LaunchScreen.storyboard are generated from this file.
____: Never hand-edit a generated value; DesignTokensTest fails when they drift.
_palette: PLACEHOLDER: every app picks its own values but keeps the shape (a warm ground, a lighter surface, solid ink, one primary, a secondary, an accent plus a darker accentText for copy).
_semantic: App-specific named colours, each emitted as Theme.<name> on both platforms; empty is fine.
_typography: A serif display face (Georgia on iOS, Noto Serif on Android) at iOS Dynamic Type Large sizes, rendered in sp on Android so the user's font-size setting scales them.
_spacing: The only spacing values a screen should use.
_card: The house card: surface, hairline border at inkSoft, soft primary-tinted shadow.
_selection: Selection reads as state, not a border ring: the chosen option lifts and stays opaque while the others recede.
_control: Segmented control: a capsule track with the primary pill on the choice.
_icon: The icon ground, a radial wash from backgroundIn at the centre to backgroundOut at the edge, used by tools/render_icon.py and the Android adaptive-icon background.
